text_block_list.text: During the summer training camp to build up our skills—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, let's gooo~! One more lap!
Bring it on, Trainer! Let's do this~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! 'Cause if I crush it now,
I can head to the festival totally hyped!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you didn't know?! Tonight, there's like,
a pretty huge summer festival at the nearby shrine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've been suuuper looking forward to it~. I'm definitely going!
I'll bust my butt right now, so no extending practice, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, if you didn't even know about it,
does that mean you're not going? What're you doing tonight?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Working this hard even at summer camp? You're crazy.
Well, whatever. I'm gonna go get ready for the next thing~

And just as promised, Tosen Jordan trained her absolute
hardest before heading off to the summer festival.
Or so it was supposed to go, until—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, found ya~ Trainer, let's roll.
choice_data_list: Wait, what about the summer festival?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, that's where we're going~.
C'mon, keep up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking, cotton candy, scooping games, and all that
make for tons of stuff to carry, right? So I need a pack mule, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Bingo~! Got it? Not taking no for an answer anyway.
Let's gooo.

And just like that, I was dragged along to the summer
festival grounds...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaah! You came too, babe?!
Wait, are you in a yukata?! And is that your boo next to you?! For real?!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Wait, shhh! Ugh, you're way too loud!
This is exactly why I didn't want you finding me~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please! You totally wanted to show off, admit it!
Gotta get photographic evidence~ Trainer, take a pic, take a pic! Woohoo~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, with just you two, all you can do is take selfies, right? I'll do it for ya.
I'll edit it super cute before sending it over~. Okay, peace signs!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, mister, what is this? The color is totally insane!
This is a choco-banana stall, right? It's so neon it's blinding me.

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, about that. You know how that 'Instagrammable' stuff is all the rage?
I tried coming up with something for the young crowd in my own way... Did I overdo it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, not at all! It's hilarious and awesome, you're a genius, old guy!
Gimme one of these, pwease~. Trainer, you want one too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Are you chickening out?
When something this epic is right here, neon is the only choice~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, quit making that serious face!
It's all about the vibe~! Oh, hold them together, let's take a pic~

And so, maintaining our comfortable distance,
I enjoyed the summer festival alongside Tosen Jordan—
(BOOOOOM...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fireworks! So freaking cool!
I totally love these!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...! For real?! We actually have something in common!
So you like fireworks too—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, who doesn't like fireworks?
Pretty much nobody. Guess that doesn't really count as clicking, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I was just thinking, like, we don't really get each other at all.
So wouldn't it be nice if we had at least one thing where we went, 'Same~'?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even if we're like total aliens to each other... we can still laugh at the same stuff, right?
That's what gave me the spark.

It seemed bringing me to the festival was Tosen Jordan's
own way of trying to connect and understand me better.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But fireworks are too generic, huh.
Yeah... way too weak. Guess we'll probably never understand each other, forever and ever.
choice_data_list: It's fine even if we don't completely understand each other.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Perhaps what matters isn't understanding each other perfectly,
but the desire to reach out and try. That felt like what she had shown me.
choice_data_list: Thank you for trying to understand me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...What's that supposed to mean? Makes zero sense.
Isn't understanding each other way better?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like with food, comedy, clothes, or vibes.
It's always better when it just clicks. Clicking without even trying is peak.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Studying stuff you don't even get, checking if the other person's vibing with it...
Doing all that is such a massive pain.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well... whatever, who cares.
The fireworks are pretty anyway...

The distance between me and Tosen Jordan, as she muttered those words, was still a bit far.
Yet with every conversation we shared, I believed that gap would slowly close—
